title: fragaria virginiana var. terrae-novae
intro: Fragaria virginiana var. terrae-novae, commonly known as a type of wild strawberry, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria virginiana var. terrae-novae include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-diarrheal effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, gastrointestinal issues, and skin problems, due to its soothing and protective effects on the body.
